mapper.select: SELECT id, role_name, description, is_system FROM roles WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, role_name AS roleName, description, is_system AS isSystem FROM roles WHERE role_name = #{roleName}

SELECT r.id, r.role_name AS roleName, r.description, r.is_system AS isSystem, COUNT(ur.user_id) AS userCount FROM roles r LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.role_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id, r.role_name, r.description, r.is_system ORDER BY r.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO roles (role_name, description, is_system) VALUES (#{roleName}, #{description}, #{isSystem})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.perm_name AS permName, p.description FROM permissions p INNER JOIN role_permissions rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission_id) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{permissionId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM role_permissions WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND permission_id = #{permissionId}
